document_metadata.document_title: NWA Stormwater BMP Manual (Fayetteville MS4 / Northwest Arkansas)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Northwest Arkansas regional Stormwater BMP Manual used by Fayetteville and peer NWA MS4s. Construction sediment traps and retention/detention sized to municipal design storms; LID Appendix B addresses rain gardens, bioretention, infiltration, and green roofs. No single regional WQv equation — follow host municipality + NWA manual.
